summary: A control machine that turns each note in its track into a chord or an arpeggio on a target machine: 51 voicings, chord or five arpeggio modes, a step and octave range with octave walks, swing, and humanised timing and velocity. It makes no sound of its own.
use_for: Turn each note in a track into a chord or arpeggio on a target machine, with many voicings.
quirks: It makes no sound of its own: it plays notes on a target generator, which must be set in the machine's own target dialog (no tool sets it).
Chord mode uses consecutive tracks of the target, one per chord tone; arpeggio modes play on one target track.
Length 0 holds each note until the next one; Speed is in pattern ticks, so it follows the song's tempo.
Its Note column (the root note) is not in the parameter list; write it with notes_write like any note.

track_parameters.name: Velocity
track_parameters.description: Note velocity sent to target (1-127). The velocity it sends
track_parameters.how: Sets the velocity sent to the target, from 1 to 127.
track_parameters.sound: Louder or brighter notes, depending on how the target uses velocity.

track_parameters.name: Chord
track_parameters.how: Chooses the chord, one of 51 voicings from triads and sevenths to shells, quartal stacks and clusters.
track_parameters.sound: Changes the mood from bright and open to dark, tense or ambiguous.

track_parameters.name: Mode
track_parameters.how: Chooses whether the chord plays at once or as an arpeggio up, down, up and down, down and up, or random.
track_parameters.sound: A chord blocks together; an arpeggio plays its notes one after another.

track_parameters.name: Speed
track_parameters.description: Pattern ticks between arp steps. Ticks between arpeggio steps
track_parameters.how: Sets the pattern ticks between arpeggio steps, from 1 to 1024.
track_parameters.sound: Smaller values give a fast arpeggio; larger ones a slow one.

track_parameters.name: Length
track_parameters.description: Note duration in ticks (0 = no auto note-off). 0 holds each note until the next
track_parameters.how: Sets how long each note holds in ticks, up to 16384; 0 holds it until the next note.
track_parameters.sound: Short lengths play staccato; 0 lets notes ring until replaced.

track_parameters.name: Octaves
track_parameters.how: Sets the octave range of the arpeggio, from 1 to 4.
track_parameters.sound: More octaves stretch the arpeggio across a wider register.

track_parameters.name: Step
track_parameters.description: Chord tones advanced per arp step
track_parameters.how: Sets how many chord tones the arpeggio advances per step, from 1 to 8.
track_parameters.sound: Skipping tones makes the arpeggio leap rather than walk.

track_parameters.name: Oct Walk
track_parameters.description: Octave cycling after each chord cycle
track_parameters.how: Cycles the octave after each pass of the chord: off, up or ping-pong.
track_parameters.sound: The arpeggio climbs or rocks through the octaves instead of repeating.

track_parameters.name: Swing
track_parameters.description: 0=straight  50=medium shuffle  100=2:1 triplet. The long step of each pair is (1 + Swing) of the short: 100 % is 2:1
track_parameters.how: Lengthens every other step, from 0 (straight) to 100 percent (a 2:1 triplet feel).

track_parameters.name: Swing On
track_parameters.how: Chooses whether the first or the second step of each pair gets the long wait.
track_parameters.sound: Shifts the shuffle from a lilt to a push.

track_parameters.name: Humanize
track_parameters.description: Random ±timing drift per arp step. Each step's timing moves by up to ±half this share of a step, at random
track_parameters.how: Moves each step's timing at random by up to half this percentage of a step.
track_parameters.sound: The arpeggio loosens from machine-exact to played by hand.

track_parameters.name: Hum. Vel
track_parameters.description: Random ±velocity variation per arp step. Each step's velocity moves by up to ±half this share of it, at random
track_parameters.how: Moves each step's velocity at random by up to half this percentage.
track_parameters.sound: Notes vary in strength like a live player's.
